items.question: Was the lump removed at the same time as the skin wart?
items.note: The lump is watched, not removed (#23-#25).

items.question: Has the patient noticed a lump on the left forearm?

items.question: Were antibiotics prescribed after the removal?
Is an ultrasound referral planned if the lump stays unchanged?
items.note: "If it is unchanged at that point, I will refer you for an ultrasound scan so we can see what it is made of."

items.question: The follow-up was set for six months from now, right?
Could the lump be a lipoma or a hematoma?
items.note: "It could be a fatty lump, what we call a lipoma, or it could be a collection of blood under the skin, a hematoma."

items.question: Did the patient feel the lump on the right forearm?
Has the lump been judged likely to be malignant?
items.note: Opposite: "a possible benign change, meaning not a dangerous one." (#20-#21).
